limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The accessible full theorem text inspected was the 2025 preprint of the motivating work; the final HAL v2 text could not be inspected through the available route. Lobry (2013), Section 4.2, is cited by the motivating paper as closely related but its section text was not accessible in the inspected record. The theorem requires growth-weighted reversible mutation and does not prove all-rate stability of the coexistence equilibrium.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: All-rate threshold theorem for growth-weighted reversible mutation in a chemostat
